name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
    - uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - name: Install
      run: npm ci
    - name: Build
      run: npm run build
    # Tar the bundle so the executable bit on the relocated wrapper survives.
    # actions/upload-artifact does not preserve unix file permissions.
    - name: Archive dist
      run: tar -cf dist.tar dist
    - name: Upload dist
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
      with:
        name: dist
        path: dist.tar

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
    - uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
      with:

        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - run: npm ci
    - run: npm run lint

  unit:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
    - uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - name: Install
      run: npm ci
    - name: Test
      run: npm test
      env:
        INPUT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  integration:
    name: Integration test
    needs: build

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - uses: $/.github/actions/dist
    - name: Use Action
      uses: ./
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    - name: Validate
      run: tflint -v

  integration-versions:
    name: 'Integration test: version (tflint_version: ${{ matrix.tflint_version }})'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tflint_version: ['v0.24.1', latest]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - uses: $/.github/actions/dist
    - name: Use Action
      id: setup-tflint
      uses: ./
      with:
        tflint_version: ${{ matrix.tflint_version }}
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    - name: Validate
      if: matrix.tflint_version != 'latest'
      run: |-
        version='${{ matrix.tflint_version }}'
        tflint -v | grep ${version:1}
    - name: Validate
      if: matrix.tflint_version == 'latest'
      run: tflint -v
    - name: Verify version output
      run: |
        if [[ "${{ matrix.tflint_version }}" == "latest" ]]; then
          expected=$(gh api repos/terraform-linters/tflint/releases/latest --jq '.tag_name' | sed 's/^v//')
        else
          version='${{ matrix.tflint_version }}'
          expected=${version:1}
        fi
        if [[ "${{ steps.setup-tflint.outputs.tflint-version }}" != "$expected" ]]; then
          echo "Expected version output '$expected', got '${{ steps.setup-tflint.outputs.tflint-version }}'"
          exit 1
        fi
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
